items.t: Ryanair: Fare Recovery And Another Buyback Support Our Buy Rating
items.sum: Ryanair's Q2 revenue increased by 4%, but higher fuel expenses pushed EBIT down 7% year over year.

items.t: Ryanair Holdings (ISE:RYA) Picks Seville For First Engine MRO Hub And Academy
items.sum: Ryanair Holdings (ISE:RYA) has chosen Seville for its first engine repair, maintenance and overhaul facility. The new Seville site is planned as a long term investment into expanded technical operations and training capacity for the airline. items.t: Ryanair: The Worst May Still Be Ahead, But It's A Buy
items.sum: Analyst rates Ryanair a Buy: its FY29-based $77 target implies 34% upside, though weak fares and expiring fuel hedges could put the target at risk.

items.t: Capital Group Div. Growers (CGDG) Buys $37.6 Million More Alphabet Pref on Thursday
items.sum: The fund bought $37.6 million of Alphabet preferred stock and $32.5 million of American Water Works, while selling $20.3 million of Truist and $18.9 million of Taiwan Semiconductor.

items.t: The £12bn fuel bill threatening to down Europe’s airlines
items.sum: European airlines are used to harsh winters. As the mercury falls across the continent, demand for flights inevitably slumps, pushing many into the red.
